we have successfully developed a new class of hybrid nanomaterials (DNase 8 and 25 AuNCs) that exhibit dual functionalities.

(1) DNase 1 encapsulated gold nanocltusters are synthesized; (2) these hybrid molecules exhibit intense fluorescence and retain native functionality; (3) these DNase 1-AuNCs are used as efficient and fast DNA contamination sensors.

the synthesis of novel hybrid molecules, which combine the optical and electronic properties of nanoclusters with the biological function of a protein.
the synthesis of novel protein-AuNC hybrid materials that retain native protein function and can be used for the development of novel biosensing platforms.
the synthesis, characterization, and applications of DNase 2: AuNC hybrid materials for DNA analysis and detection.
